intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: A courtier carrying a tureen of soup bows to Tavri. His hat keeps going. The soup, narrowly, does not.

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “I held a door for that man. That’s all. Three people clapped, and one asked for an encore.”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “I could hold it again. Slower. Add a little flourish on the hinge.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Her tail is already rehearsing the flourish.

options.labelText: “Or you could let the door retire. It’s had a big day.”
“Do it. Big flourish. Give them their money’s worth.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She gives the hinge a magnificent flourish. Two more people clap.

options.labelText: “You only held it so they’d clap. Bit fake, isn’t it?”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “He was carrying soup. But please, keep reviewing me.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She leaves through the door. She does not hold it.
